notes: MOSS benchmark fixtures. boxes are editor coordinates (0-1000 x/y/w/h, top-left origin) exactly as the UI stores them; moss_benchmark compiles them with the same maths as src/prompt-moss.js buildMossLayout (abs_centralized yxyx, top-layer-first items).
expected_text drives OCR character-error-rate scoring; expected_regions (normalized boxes) drive layout IoU. Fields are evaluation expectations, never sent to the model.
dims are the recommended canvas; the runner may override per resolution bucket.
